title: config.py host-interval list --output-mode json
description: Every per-endpoint minimum request interval an operator has set (host_settings, GitHub issue #244), one row per endpoint, ordered by host. An endpoint not listed uses the post-processing default (0.5 s), named in the note.

notes.description: One note naming the default interval of endpoints not listed.

rows.description: Ordered by host. Empty when no endpoint has an override.

host.description: The endpoint's throttle key (scheme, host[:port] and the first two path segments of its URL), as in host_activity.

min_interval_seconds.description: Minimum interval between requests to the endpoint, from all post-processing workers together, replacing the default in either direction.

note.description: Why the override exists; null when none was given.

updated_at.description: When the override was last set, UTC.
